d:
Being in a relationship is hard.
Being in a relationship with someone who's obsessed with football? That's a whole different sport.
This FilterCopy short film is about every girlfriend who's had to compete with "just five more minutes"… only to realize those five minutes somehow last an entire match.
The plans get postponed.
The conversations become football analogies.
And somehow, every weekend is already booked.
But when you're in love with someone, you slowly learn that loving them also means understanding the things they love, even if you don't always get the hype.
